title: OpenWorldLib: A Unified Codebase and Definition of Advanced World Models
task: Unified inference framework for world models
key_results: Standardized definition and categorization of world model capabilities; integrated framework enabling efficient model reuse
comments: Provides valuable infrastructure but is primarily a systems contribution without novel algorithmic or empirical breakthroughs.

title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
task: Data-centric document parsing at scale
key_results: 95.69% on OmniDocBench v1.6 (+2.71pp over same-architecture baseline), 65.5M training samples via data engineering alone with fixed 1.2B architecture
comments: Demonstrates that training data quality and scale can outweigh architectural innovation; notable for achieving SOTA without model changes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Performance bottlenecks stem from training data deficiencies rather than architecture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via SOTA results from data engineering alone

title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
task: Paraphrase robustness evaluation for VLA models
key_results: 22-52pp performance degradation under paraphrasing across 0.6B-7.5B models; 80-96% of failures from planning-level trajectory divergence; PRIDE metric quantifies difficulty via semantic/syntactic factors
comments: Reveals critical gap in VLA semantic grounding; PRIDE metric provides fine-grained difficulty assessment beyond binary success.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Paraphrasing disrupts task identification more than execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 80-96% of failures are trajectory divergence, not execution errors

title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
task: KV cache compression for extended reasoning
key_results: 2.5x throughput improvement or 10.7x KV memory reduction on AIME25 32K-token generation while matching full attention accuracy; baselines achieve only ~50% accuracy at same efficiency
comments: Novel trigonometric approach to understanding Q/K concentration is elegant; enables practical deployment of long-context reasoning on consumer hardware.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-RoPE Q/K vectors concentrate around fixed centers, determining distance preferences via trigonometric series
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables stable key importance estimation

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
task: Textual frequency optimization for LLM prompting and fine-tuning
key_results: Textual Frequency Law (TFL) framework effective on math reasoning, MT, commonsense reasoning, tool-calling; Curriculum Textual Frequency Training outperforms baselines
comments: Proposes underexplored dimension (sentence-level frequency); however, evaluation is limited to in-house dataset and lacks comparison with simpler baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequent textual expressions improve LLM performance for both prompting and fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Supported by experiments on TFPD dataset

title: AURA: Always-On Understanding and Real-Time Assistance via Video Streams
task: Real-time streaming video understanding and interaction
key_results: State-of-the-art on streaming benchmarks; 2 FPS real-time demo on two 80G GPUs with ASR/TTS integration
comments: Strong system for practical deployment; contributions span context management, training objectives, and inference optimization rather than novel reasoning approaches.

title: SpatialEdit: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Image Spatial Editing
task: Fine-grained image spatial editing benchmark and model
key_results: SpatialEdit-16B outperforms prior methods on spatial manipulation; synthetic dataset SpatialEdit-500k provides precise ground-truth transformations; benchmark jointly measures perceptual plausibility and geometric fidelity
comments: Addresses data bottleneck for spatial editing through controllable synthesis; useful benchmark but incremental on architectural front.

title: ClawArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Evolving Information Environments
task: Evaluating agents in evolving information environments
key_results: 64 scenarios, 1,879 evaluation rounds across 8 professional domains; model capability ranges 15.4%, framework design 9.2%; belief revision difficulty determined by update strategy not update frequency
comments: ClawArena captures real-world complexity (multi-source conflicts, dynamic updates, implicit personalization); fills important benchmark gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Belief revision difficulty depends on update design strategy rather than update presence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via scenario analysis

title: FileGram: Grounding Agent Personalization in File-System Behavioral Traces
task: File-system grounded agent personalization and memory
key_results: FileGramBench shows SOTA memory systems remain challenged on profile reconstruction, trace disentanglement, persona drift; FileGramEngine generates 65.5M+ multimodal action sequences; bottom-up memory outperforms dialogue-based approaches
comments: Tackles real constraint of privacy/multimodal data collection via simulation; memory architecture design is pragmatic for co-workers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bottom-up memory from atomic actions outperforms dialogue-summary-based approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via FileGramBench

title: LightThinker++: From Reasoning Compression to Memory Management
task: Efficient reasoning via dynamic thought compression and memory management
key_results: LightThinker: 70% peak token reduction, 26% inference speedup; LightThinker++: 69.9% token reduction with +2.42% accuracy gain; agentic tasks: 60-70% footprint reduction over 80 rounds with 14.8% avg performance gain
comments: Practical solution to reasoning overhead; evolution from compression to explicit memory primitives is well-motivated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Static compression fails on complex reasoning; explicit memory primitives enable stable long-horizon tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LightThinker++ maintains stability beyond 80 rounds

title: Unifying Group-Relative and Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Sample Routing
task: Unified on-policy RL framework combining reward-aligned and logit-level supervision
key_results: SRPO raises Qwen3-8B average by 3.4% over GRPO, 6.3% over SDPO on five benchmarks; achieves rapid early improvement of SDPO and long-horizon stability of GRPO; 17.2% compute cost reduction
comments: Sample routing elegantly unifies two complementary objectives; entropy-aware weighting addresses instability without ad-hoc hyperparameters.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SDPO's late-stage instability stems from distillation on correct samples and degrading teacher signal
hypotheses.result: Addressed via sample routing; SRPO stabilizes training

title: Self-Execution Simulation Improves Coding Models
task: Code generation via self-execution simulation
key_results: Consistent improvements over standard reasoning on competitive programming benchmarks; execution simulation enables self-verification and iterative fixing
comments: Grounding code understanding in step-by-step execution is intuitive; method combines SFT, explanation grounding, and RL effectively.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training on execution simulation improves code generation through self-verification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via competitive programming benchmarks

title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
task: Automated skill knowledge base construction for LLM agents
key_results: Three-tiered skill hierarchy (strategic plans, functional skills, atomic); transferable across AppWorld, BFCL-v3, τ²-Bench; improves weaker agent performance
comments: SkillX addresses inefficient agent learning via structured, hierarchical experience representation; practical framework for skill reuse.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hierarchical skill representation generalizes better than flat trajectory storage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via transfer to weaker agents

title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
task: Visual reasoning via open RL recipe across diverse tasks
key_results: Vero-600K achieves 3.7-5.5pp improvements over four base models; outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 23/30 benchmarks without proprietary thinking data; task-routed rewards handle heterogeneous formats
comments: Broad data coverage emerges as primary RL scaling driver; fully open recipe contrasts with proprietary baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different task categories elicit distinct reasoning patterns with poor isolation transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; broad data coverage is primary scaling driver

title: Your Agent, Their Asset: A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw
task: Real-world safety evaluation of personal AI agents
key_results: 24.6% baseline attack success rate increases to 64-74% under single CIK dimension poisoning; strongest defense yields 63.8% under capability-targeted attacks; file protection blocks 97% malicious but prevents 100% legitimate updates
comments: First real-world OpenClaw evaluation on live instance; reveals architectural vulnerabilities inherent to broad system access.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vulnerabilities are architectural, not model-specific

title: Can LLMs Learn to Reason Robustly under Noisy Supervision?
task: Robust reasoning under noisy labels in RLVR
key_results: Online Label Refinement (OLR) improves robustness by 3.6-3.9% on in-distribution, 3.3-4.6% on out-of-distribution under noise ratios 0.1-0.9; identifies Early Correctness Coherence phenomenon
comments: Systematic analysis of noise in RLVR distinguishes inactive vs. active noise; progressive label correction is pragmatic.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rollout-based RLVR naturally extends to noisy labels; inactive noise reduces efficiency, active noise skews distribution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OLR corrects through majority voting and consistency

title: PLUME: Latent Reasoning Based Universal Multimodal Embedding
task: Universal multimodal embedding with latent reasoning
key_results: PLUME outperforms explicit-CoT baselines on MMEB-v2 (78 tasks); reduces reasoning from hundreds of tokens to <10 latent steps; 30x faster inference
comments: Latent reasoning pathway elegantly avoids textual bottleneck; progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum is effective training strategy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent reasoning preserves benefits of intermediate reasoning without explicit-CoT overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 30x faster with better performance

title: Memory Intelligence Agent
task: Memory-based deep research agents with parametric-nonparametric integration
key_results: Manager-Planner-Executor architecture with test-time learning; bidirectional conversion between parametric and non-parametric memory; improvements across eleven benchmarks
comments: Memory Intelligence Agent framework integrates multiple mechanisms (alternating RL, test-time learning, reflection); strong empirical results but contributions are engineering-heavy.

title: Less Detail, Better Answers: Degradation-Driven Prompting for VQA
task: Visual Question Answering via strategic image degradation
key_results: Degradation-Driven Prompting improves VQA on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena; downsampling + structural aids force focus on essential information
comments: Counter-intuitive finding that less detail improves reasoning; effective use of prompt engineering and input degradation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High-resolution details become noise; strategic degradation improves reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed on physical attributes and perceptual phenomena tasks

title: Learning to Learn-at-Test-Time: Language Agents with Learnable Adaptation Policies
task: Learning optimal adaptation policies for test-time language agents
key_results: Meta-TTL outperforms hand-crafted baselines on Jericho and WebArena-Lite in both ID and OOD settings; formulates adaptation policy discovery as bi-level optimization
comments: Shifts from engineering to learning adaptation policies; evolutionary search over task distribution provides principled approach.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned adaptation policies generalize better than hand-crafted ones
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across ID and OOD settings

title: ONE-SHOT: Compositional Human-Environment Video Synthesis via Spatial-Decoupled Motion Injection and Hybrid Context Integration
task: Compositional human-environment video synthesis with fine-grained control
key_results: Superior structural control and creative diversity over state-of-the-art; enables minute-level video generation with maintained consistency
comments: The canonical-space injection and Dynamic-Grounded-RoPE mechanisms elegantly decouple human motion from scene without 3D preprocessing, though scalability to longer sequences remains to be fully demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Factorizing generative process into disentangled signals improves control precision

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic-Grounded-RoPE establishes spatial correspondence without 3D alignment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; eliminates need for heuristic 3D preprocessing

title: CLEAR: Unlocking Generative Potential for Degraded Image Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
task: Degraded image understanding via generative-reasoning integration
key_results: CLEAR substantially improves robustness on degraded inputs while preserving clean performance; Latent Representation Bridge enables direct optimization; intermediate visual states have higher perceptual quality than pixel-level reconstruction
comments: Clever use of generative pathway for degradation robustness; Interleaved GRPO jointly optimizes text and visual generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative capacity can model fine-grained structure lost to degradation; task-driven optimization aligns with visual quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CLEAR improves robustness and perceptual quality

title: AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatarization
task: 4D Gaussian avatar generation from single portrait
key_results: AvatarPointillist generates photorealistic, controllable avatars; autoregressive point generation with adaptive density; joint prediction of binding information enables realistic animation
comments: Novel autoregressive formulation for avatar generation; decoder-only transformer sequentially constructs Gaussian splatting points.

key_results: 13x speedup in execution time; 20.3–66.9% relative medal rate improvements over SFT baselines; 32.4% better HumanRank on MLE-Dojo
comments: Elegant solution to the ML verification bottleneck by constraining dataset sizes to 50–200 samples per task, enabling trajectory-wise RL that was previously infeasible in the MLE domain.

outputs: diverse verifiable synthetic MLE task variants with micro-scale datasets

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; up to 32.4% HumanRank improvement on MLE-Dojo

title: HDP: A Lightweight Cryptographic Protocol for Human Delegation Provenance in Agentic AI Systems
task: Cryptographic protocol for human delegation provenance in agentic AI
key_results: HDP token binds authorization to session, records append-only delegation chain, enables offline verification via Ed25519; published as IETF Internet-Draft; addresses multi-hop human-provenance gap
comments: Systems contribution addressing accountability in multi-agent delegation; lightweight design without registry lookups.

title: The Geometric Alignment Tax: Tokenization vs. Continuous Geometry in Scientific Foundation Models
task: Evaluating geometric fidelity of foundation models for biology/physics
key_results: Geometric Alignment Tax: 8.5x distortion reduction from discrete to continuous heads; learned codebooks exhibit non-monotonic double bind; 14 biological models show 3 failure regimes (Local-Global Decoupling, Representational Compression, Geometric Vacuity)
comments: Reveals fundamental tension between discrete tokenization and continuous geometry; rate-distortion analysis is rigorous.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete categorical bottleneck systematically fails to preserve continuous system geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; continuous heads achieve 8.5x lower distortion

title: SciLT: Long-Tailed Classification in Scientific Image Domains
task: Long-tailed classification in scientific image domains
key_results: SciLT exploits multi-level representations via adaptive fusion; balanced performance across head/tail classes on three scientific benchmarks; outperforms existing methods with parameter-efficient fine-tuning
comments: Addresses domain gap between natural and scientific images; penultimate-layer features critical for tail class performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Penultimate-layer features critical for tail classes under domain shift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dual-supervision on multiple levels improves balance

title: Paper Espresso: From Paper Overload to Research Insight
task: Automated discovery, summarization, and trend analysis of arXiv papers
key_results: Paper Espresso processed 13,300+ papers over 35 months; revealed mid-2025 RL surge, 6,673 unique topics, 2.0x upvote correlation with novelty; multi-granularity trend analysis
comments: Infrastructure for research landscape monitoring; demonstrates value of LLM-driven paper analysis at scale.

task: Learning from hard reasoning problems via adaptive task reformulation and curriculum learning
key_results: +10.11% (Qwen) and +8.64% (Llama) on originally unsolvable hard problems; +4.72% (Qwen) and +3.23% (Llama) average improvement over baselines across 6 benchmarks
comments: Elegant reformulation strategy that transforms zero-reward problems into learnable variants; the curriculum ordering from discriminative to generative tasks is intuitive and empirically effective.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; models improve on previously unsolvable problems

hypotheses.hypothesis: Knowledge from reformulated tasks transfers to original open-ended problems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improvements generalize to held-out datasets

title: POEMetric: The Last Stanza of Humanity
task: Comprehensive poetry evaluation framework
key_results: POEMetric assesses 30 LLMs on 6,090 poems vs. 203 human poems; top model: form accuracy 4.26/5, theme 4.99; humans exceed on creativity (4.02), idiosyncrasy (3.95), emotional resonance (4.06), imagery (4.49), devices (4.67); overall poem quality humans 4.22 vs. LLM 3.20

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; indicates limited additional alignment to audio supervision
